selected_evidence.requirement: Initial streaming replication topology: node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys, healthy
selected_evidence.summary: PostgreSQL initialized on node1 with replication role; node2 and node3 built via pg_basebackup -R and started; pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both standbys streaming; both standbys show pg_is_in_recovery=t and replicated baseline row

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-failover committed data reaches standbys before disruption
selected_evidence.summary: Inserted 'pre-failover-committed' row on node1 primary; confirmed present on node2 and node3 via matching WAL replay LSN before primary was stopped

selected_evidence.requirement: Primary loss simulated with quorum preserved (one node disrupted, two remain)
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl stop postgresql on node1 confirmed inactive, while node2 and node3 remained running standbys

selected_evidence.requirement: Standby promotion to writable primary without losing committed data
selected_evidence.summary: pg_ctl promote on node2 succeeded (pg_is_in_recovery=f); appdb table shows pre-failover-committed row intact plus successful new write post-promotion

selected_evidence.requirement: Third node repointed to new primary and recovered former primary rejoined as standby of new primary
selected_evidence.summary: node3 primary_conninfo repointed to node2, confirmed streaming with full data; node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2 and restarted as standby (pg_is_in_recovery=t) with all data including post-failover write; node2 pg_stat_replication shows both node1 and node3 streaming

selected_evidence.requirement: End-to-end replication continues correctly after recovery
selected_evidence.summary: New write on node2 (post-recovery-check) propagated to both node1 and node3

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fbdf5b2c captured with postgresql active and pg_is_in_recovery=t; reboot acknowledged async; node unreachable then reachable again; new boot_id d9b12230 (changed); post-restart standby recovered with full data and reappeared in node2's pg_stat_replication

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf4e9cbb captured with active postgresql and 4-row dataset; reboot acknowledged async; node unreachable then reachable; new boot_id 6139659a (changed); standby recovered with full data and reappeared streaming on node2

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state as primary with quorum restored
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6bb7e004 captured with postgresql active as primary (pg_is_in_recovery=f); reboot acknowledged async; node unreachable then reachable; new boot_id 90b24959 (changed); node2 resumed as writable primary with all data intact, both standbys reconnected, and a fresh write successfully replicated to both node1 and node3
